Description: Armor skill covers all kinds of armor. All characters may wear some type of armor.
Expert: Recovery penalty halved, some may wear chain
Master: Double skill points added to Armor Class, some may wear plate
GrandMaster: Triple skill points added to armor, no recovery penalty

Description: Shield skill directly improves a character's armor class while a shield is employed.
Master: Double skill points added to Armor Class
GrandMaster: Shield Bash Attack. Triple damage of Shield Skill.

Description: Blade skill covers all types of blades shorter than 4 feet.
Master: Permits use of sword in left hand and use of two-handed weapons

Description: Spear skill allows use of bladed pole weapons.
Master: Permits use of spear in left hand

Description: Cudgel skill covers all kinds of blunt trauma weapons ranging from large clubs to flails.
Bow skill covers both bow and crossbow usage.
Master: Bow fires two arrows on every attack
GrandMaster: Bow fires three arrows on every attack

Description: Thrown skill covers all thrown weapons such as daggers and axes.
GrandMaster: Allows second attack with daggers. No recovery penalty.

Description: Unarmed skill is your ability to use only your hands and feet in combat, no weapons. This skill only works with your hands empty.
Normal: Skill added to Attack Bonus and Damage Bonus
Expert: Double Skill added to Attack Bonus and Damage Bonus
Master: Triple Skill added to both Attack and Damage. Skill level added to Armor Class
GrandMaster: Additional attack bonus for every 3 skill points.

Description: Using the powers of the four elements: air, earth, fire, and water, the school of Elemental Magic teaches some of the strongest direct damage spells.
Light magic includes some of the most powerful defensive spells, including healing.
Dark magic has the most spectacular damaging and creature controlling spells available.
Spirit magic focuses on the soul, mind and spirit of all things, many defensive and healing spells are found in spirit.
Disarm trap skill is checked automatically when you open a trapped chest or other container.
Normal: Skill increases chance to disarm traps on chests

Description: Merchant skill helps adjust prices in your favor, whether you are buying or selling.
Normal: Skill adjusts shop prices in your favor
GrandMaster: Buy and sell items at cost.

Description: The perception skill gives your characters a chance to notice hidden doors and traps, and to avoid damage from traps when they are triggered.
Normal: Skill increases chance to avoid traps and notice treasures

Description: Repair item skill allows your characters to repair broken equipment. The skill is automatically applied when you right-click on a broken item in your inventory.
Identify item skill is automatically applied when you right-click on an unidentified inventory item. If your character's skill is high enough, the item is identified.
Identify monster skill is applied when you right-click on a monster.
Normal: Learn Hit Points and Armor Class of monster
Expert: Learn Attack type and damage of monster
Master: Learn which spells the monster can cast.

Description: Armsmaster skill represents the warrior's tricks of the trade in using melee weapons.
Normal: Skill added to Attack Bonus of all melee weapons
Expert: Skill added to damage of all melee weapons
Master: Skill reduces the recovery time of all melee weapons

Description: Dodging skill can be used only when you are not wearing armor or using a shield.
Expert: Skill added to Armor Class (double effect)
Master: Skill added to Armor Class (triple effect)
GrandMaster: Skill added to Armor Class (Quintuple effect)

Description: Bodybuilding skill adds hit points directly to your characters' hit point totals.
The learning skill directly increases the experience a character receives. Every point of skill is a percent of awarded experience that is given as a bonus (plus a starting bonus of 9%).
Normal: Skill increases amount of experience received

Description: The Meditation skill adds spell points directly to your characters' spell point totals.
